name: CoCreation Grass Co., Ltd
summary: CoCreation Grass Co., Ltd research, development, production, and sales of artificial turf in China and internationally. The company offers artificial sports turf for football, hockey, rugby, tennis, padel, and multi-sport turfs; and leisure turf for residential, commercial, DIY, playground, pet, and other landscape purposes. It also provides artificial plants under the EdenVert brand name. In addition, the company offers turf system installation products, including turf infill materials, elastic mats, installation engineering services, etc.; and engages in trading activities.
